resources.string: Ride by effort: big zone-colored number and Ride, Effort, Weather, Lap, Analysis, Workout and Bike panels. Put it alone on a page; tap the top to switch power/speed/HR, tap left or right of the panel to flip.
Wind compass that turns with your heading: green tailwind, red headwind, yellow crosswind.
W\' balance in kJ (Skiba model, CP from your FTP unless set in KarooPRO).
Headwind (+) or tailwind (-) for your direction of travel, from Open-Meteo.
